run_import_parquet_edgelist: run the import_from_parquet CLI to convert parquet edge list files into TorchBigGraph format using a config file
run_convert_parquet_with_columns: run import_from_parquet with --lhs-col and --rhs-col to specify source and target entity columns in parquet files
run_convert_parquet_with_weights: run import_from_parquet with --weight-col to include edge weights when converting parquet edge list data
run_convert_parquet_with_min_counts: run import_from_parquet with --entity-min-count and --relation-type-min-count to filter sparse entities and relations
run_convert_parquet_with_relations: run import_from_parquet with --rel-col to specify the relation type column when converting parquet edge lists
